notes: Stay in Ao Nang (Railay is expensive, Krabi Town is quiet). The longtail to Railay costs 100 THB; Grab and scooters are available; the airport minibus costs 150.
May to October is the RAIN season: afternoon downpours, rough seas, some island tours cancelled, and Maya Bay CLOSED in August and September. It's cheap and green, so book morning tours.
Fill in the TDAC digital arrival card; carry cash in THB. Island tours cost 1,000-2,500 plus the 400 park fee; a taverna meal costs 200-400; round up your tips.
Go to Tiger Cave at 07:00 (heat and monkeys), take the 08:00 slot at Maya Bay, and expect the Four Islands to be crowded midday. Bring reef-safe sunscreen and water shoes.
You'll get wet on the morning longtail (bring a dry bag); ATMs are few in Railay.
Southern Thai food: massaman, gaeng som (sour curry), roti and seafood with coconut. Muslim villages serve halal food.

stops.name: Railay West Beach
stops.tips: 15 minutes by longtail boat from Ao Nang (100 THB). A beach between limestone towers, quiet in the morning and a hub for rock climbing.

stops.name: Phra Nang Cave Beach
stops.tips: One of the world's most beautiful beaches. Visit the princess cave (with its phallus offerings), snorkel, and buy food from longtail boats.

stops.name: Railay Viewpoint & Lagoon
stops.tips: A red-earth rope scramble (short but steep). The view is great, and descending to the lagoon takes nerve.

stops.name: Mangrove Restaurant Railay East
stops.tips: Thai dishes at the mangrove's edge. Try the green curry.

stops.name: Ao Nang Sunset Wang Sai
stops.tips: Seafood at the far end of Ao Nang. Watch the sunset, then take the 17:30 longtail back.

backups.name: Tonsai Beach
backups.tips: A hippie climbers' beach. Walk there at low tide, as an alternative to the viewpoint.

backups.name: Krua Thara Seafood Klong Muang
backups.tips: A local seafood favourite in Klong Muang.

stops.name: Four Islands Tour Ao Nang
stops.tips: Longtail (1,000) or speedboat (1,500). The 400 national park fee is extra.

stops.name: Koh Poda
stops.tips: White sand and a towering rock. Snorkel here: it is Ao Nang's postcard view.

stops.name: Chicken Island Koh Gai
stops.tips: A rock shaped like a chicken's head. Snorkel among the fish.

stops.name: Koh Tup Sandbar Lunch
stops.tips: At low tide a sandbar (Talay Waek) joins three islands. Rice lunch included.

stops.name: Phra Nang Cave & Return
stops.tips: The last stop is Phra Nang. Back in Ao Nang at 16:00.

backups.name: Hong Island Tour
backups.tips: Hong's lagoon and a 360° viewpoint. Choose it instead of the Four Islands tour (as long as it isn't on the next day).

backups.name: Ao Nang Night Market
backups.tips: A night market from Friday to Sunday. Try pad thai and mango sticky rice.

stops.name: Hong Island Speedboat
stops.tips: 30 minutes from Ao Nang, in Than Bok Khorani National Park.

stops.name: Hong Lagoon
stops.tips: A hidden lagoon ringed by limestone towers. Go kayaking.

stops.name: Koh Hong Main Beach
stops.tips: White sand and coral. The 360° viewing platform (419 steps) was built in 2019.

stops.name: Koh Hong Picnic Lunch
stops.tips: Included in the tour. Eat on the beach.

stops.name: Koh Lao Lading & Pakbia
stops.tips: A small cove on Paradise Island. Snorkel, then head back at 16:00.

backups.name: Krabi Town Chao Fah Night Market
backups.tips: Riverside evening food stalls in Krabi Town.

backups.name: Tup Kaek Beach
backups.tips: If you skip the tour: a quiet beach north of Ao Nang. Come for the sunset.

stops.name: Tiger Cave Temple Wat Tham Suea
stops.tips: 1,260 steps (steep!). At the top you'll find a Buddha and a 360° panorama. It's cool at 07:00; watch for monkeys and bring water.

stops.name: Krabi Town Breakfast Ruen Mai
stops.tips: A garden restaurant serving Thai and southern dishes.

stops.name: Emerald Pool Sa Morakot
stops.tips: An emerald-green natural pool in the forest (1 km wooden walkway). It lies in Khao Phra Bang Khram, 1 hour by car.

stops.name: Blue Pool
stops.tips: A blue spring where swimming is forbidden, 800 m beyond the Emerald Pool.

stops.name: Klong Thom Hot Springs
stops.tips: Hot spring pools at 40°C in a forest stream, plus a waterfall.

backups.name: Khao Khanab Nam Caves
backups.tips: A longtail ride from Krabi Town. Explore a cave between two rocks and the mangroves, instead of the pool.

backups.name: Ko Klang Village Lunch
backups.tips: Home cooking in a Muslim fishing village. Get there by boat.

stops.name: Phi Phi Speedboat Ao Nang
stops.tips: 45 minutes by speedboat (tour about 2,500 THB). The national park fee is 400.

stops.name: Maya Bay
stops.tips: The bay is closed in August and September (coral recovery). Visit Pileh Lagoon instead.

stops.name: Pileh Lagoon & Viking Cave
stops.tips: Swim in the emerald lagoon. See the swiftlet nest cave from outside.

stops.name: Phi Phi Don Tonsai Lunch
stops.tips: Buffet included in the tour, in the island village.

stops.name: Bamboo Island
stops.tips: White sand and snorkelling. Head back at 16:30.

backups.name: Phi Phi Viewpoint
backups.tips: The classic view over two bays, a 20-minute climb. Do it instead of Bamboo.

stops.name: Klong Muang Beach
stops.tips: Ao Nang's quiet neighbour. A resort beach with good swimming.

stops.name: Tub Kaek Beach
stops.tips: An empty beach with views of the Hong islands. It's also the start of the Dragon Crest (Khao Ngon Nak) hike.

stops.name: Lae Lay Grill
stops.tips: A famous hilltop Thai restaurant with sea views, in Ao Nang.

stops.name: Thai Cooking Class Ya's Krabi
stops.tips: A half-day cooking course with a market visit and 5 dishes.

backups.name: Khao Ngon Nak Dragon Crest
backups.tips: A 3.7 km forest climb with cliff and rock views. Do it instead of the beach.

backups.name: Jenna's Bistro Ao Nang
backups.tips: Thai and Western cuisine. Go in the evening, instead of the class.

days.theme: Ao Nang morning and an easy farewell

stops.name: Ao Nang Beach Morning Walk
stops.tips: Longtail boats in the morning. Take the Monkey Trail to Pai Plong beach.

stops.name: Pai Plong Beach
stops.tips: The Centara cove. Snorkel and look out for monkeys.

stops.name: Café 8.98 Ao Nang
stops.tips: Breakfast and coffee for your farewell.

stops.name: Krabi Airport Minibus
stops.tips: 40 minutes from Ao Nang. Time to say goodbye.

backups.name: Ao Nang Landmark Night Market Morning
